HediffDef.label: talks to the plants (habit)
HediffDef.description: Talks to the plants while tending them. Whatever the plants make of it, the work goes faster.

HediffDef.label: names every animal (habit)
HediffDef.description: Has a name for every animal in the colony and uses it. The animals seem to take to them sooner.

HediffDef.label: can't stand a mess (habit)
HediffDef.description: Can't leave a mess alone. Cleans faster than most, out of sheer irritation.

HediffDef.label: sings at the stove (habit)
HediffDef.description: Sings while cooking, and keeps time by scrubbing hands and pots between songs. Food poisoning is rarer from this cook.

HediffDef.label: remembers every birthday (habit)
HediffDef.description: Knows everyone's birthday and never forgets one. People warm to that.

HediffDef.label: always whittling (habit)
HediffDef.description: Always has a knife and a bit of wood on the go in idle moments, so is seldom bored.
